node.statement: If delta := W.c0_cb*epsilon satisfies delta <= 1/2, then for every m in S and its witnessing extended delta-inclusion w:C^m->A, def-extended-delta-inclusion at amplification n=1 gives ||w(x)|| >= (1-delta)||x|| >= (1/2)||x|| for all x in C^m; thus w is injective, so finite-dimensional linear algebra gives m=dim_C(C^m) <= dim_C A.
